values.note: Three loops: A (51 electric, 30- and 50-amp, a few full hookup), B (56 electric 30-amp, nearly all with water) and C (22 electric 50-amp with water, several full hookup, plus 17 nonelectric). Gravel pads; listed max vehicle length 40-83 ft, most 50-70 ft. One wheeled camper and two tents (or three tents) per pad; all equipment must fit on the pad.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id%3A233441 (loop, type, Electricity/Water/Sewer Hookup, Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Surface; 145 bookable + B012 not bookable) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233441 (notice 'There is a limit of 1 wheeled camper and 2 tents or 3 tents per camp pad. All equipment must fit on the site pad'), read 2026-11-09

values.note: Showers, laundry, dump station, playground, boat ramp, day-use swimming beach and a mile-long hiking trail; Bucksaw Point Marina next door.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233441 (Facilities: 'flush and pit toilets, showers, drinking water, laundry facilities and a dump station. A boat ramp, playground and swimming beach'; Recreation: hiking trail, marina), read 2026-11-09

values.note: Reservable on recreation.gov, Mar 1 - Nov 30 (no rate and no calendar December - February). A permit from the park booth is required before setting up.

note: Large USACE campground on a peninsula in the Grand River arm of Truman Lake, south of Highway 7 near Clinton. Loops A and B sit in scattered shade on the peninsula's east side, loop C on the west shore. A few sites see the lake through the shoreline trees, such as A062 and the nonelectric C105 and C108, which sit about 20 m above a rocky bank. Day-use swimming beach, boat ramp, and a marina next door. --Claude
summary: Confirmed from rec.gov: 146 sites (A/B/C), 30- and 50-amp, water at 84, full hookup at 15; $14-$24 off peak, $20-$40 peak (stored $14-25 updated); reservable Mar 1 - Nov 30 with 2/3-night weekend/holiday minimums. Lakeview kept: C105/C108 (~15-20 m above the shore ledge) and A062 see the lake across a brush line, no pad earns lakefront. Phone 660-477-3402 to add; pin is the rec.gov facility point, move to the loops.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakeview, kept): every pad sits back from the shore. Closest are the nonelectric C-loop sites on the west shore: C105 ~17 m and C108 ~20 m from the water edge, measured on the 0.4 m/px leaf-off frame, atop a rocky drawdown ledge. The rec.gov photos of both show the lake across a strip of grass and a shrub/tree line at the bank, so there is no open apron and lakefront is not earned. On the east side A059-A062 sit ~90-120 m from the cove behind a wooded strip, though the A062 photo shows the lake beyond a hedge. Loop B's east edge (B041-B045) is ~120-140 m back behind woods. The day-use beach is at the east cove south of loop A. Lakeview rests on C105/C108/C110 and A062.
PHONE: rec.gov lists 660-477-3402; the entry has no phone. apply.py doesn't write it, so add it by hand.

PIN: stored 38.2600,-93.6056 is the rec.gov facility point (38.26,-93.6055556). It lands in the woods ~800 m NW of the loops near the entry road. Suggest moving it to 38.2531,-93.5981, the centroid of the 145 plotted sites, which sits between loops A/B and the beach road. One catalog site plots at 38.20998,-93.50469, ~9 km away; it's a placeholder and was ignored.

SEASON: no rate table or calendar exists for December-February, so booking.season is written as 03-01..11-30. The campground 'season' group is left absent because no page says whether it is closed or open FCFS in winter. Calendar quirk: 2026-11-01 shows 129 sites 'Not Reservable' and 2026-11-05 shows the whole park 'Closed' for a day.
RATES: the stored $14-25 came from an off-peak table. The peak rates are $20 nonelectric / $30 / $35 / $40 full hookup.

MIN STAY: the notice text gives 2 nights on weekends and 3 on holiday weekends. rec.gov's rules record minWeekendStay/minHolidayWeekendStay as 0 'soft', so the system may not enforce them. Both are written as min_stay from the notice.
DISCOUNT: rec.gov rules list 'militaryDiscount' = 1. Not written; it may only be rec.gov's pass handling.
max_rig_ft: the derived 70 is replaced by 83, the catalog's longest Max Vehicle Length (C104).
Note rewritten: hookup counts and the rig/booking text are dropped because the fields now hold them.
